SELECT clock_timestamp() AS sampled_at, pid, application_name, state, wait_event_type, wait_event,
       now() - query_start AS query_age, left(query, $1) AS query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = current_database() AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
ORDER BY query_start
